purpose: Bind inherited NUI craft owners and v8 media owners into one falsifiable high-ambition visual direction without creating duplicate skill ownership.
principle: Exceptional visual quality is not a style preset or a scalar score. It is the convergence of product-specific intent, materially divergent exploration, controlled hierarchy, resolved craft systems, subject-native representation, responsive recomposition and observed correction in the rendered product.

planes.name: visual thesis
planes.owns: one sentence that states what the interface should feel like, what carries authority, and what must visually recede
planes.rejects: adjective piles such as premium, modern, clean, beautiful with no product mechanism

planes.name: material direction divergence
planes.owns: at least three candidates that differ in composition, type system, material model and signature mechanism before convergence
planes.rejects: three colorways of one layout or renamed variants of the same component stack

planes.name: attention architecture
planes.owns: a ranked visual path with one primary focal role and deliberately subordinate regions
planes.rejects: equal-weight card fields, democratic contrast and accidental focal competition

planes.name: typographic voice and optical hierarchy
planes.owns: functional type roles, readable measure, fallback behavior and deliberate contrast between narrative, reading, utility and numerical content
planes.rejects: one undifferentiated sans scale, fragile ultra-light display text and typography chosen only by fashion

planes.name: composition rhythm
planes.owns: grid logic, density cadence, edge behavior, focal interruption and breakpoint-specific structural transformation
planes.rejects: container stacking where every region becomes the same rounded rectangle and mobile is desktop compressed

planes.name: color and material causality
planes.owns: semantic palette, chroma allocation, depth model, surface behavior and dark-mode remapping
planes.rejects: blanket glass, random gradients, identical elevation on every surface and simple color inversion

planes.name: temporal continuity
planes.owns: motion purpose, gesture relation, timing character and reduced-motion equivalent
planes.rejects: animation as decoration, long blocking transitions and motion that contradicts spatial causality

planes.name: domain-native memory hook
planes.owns: a recognizable mechanism that is derived from subject truth, useful more than once, and constrained by a restraint rule
planes.rejects: logo placement, one hero gimmick, generic glow/orb/noise motifs and copied trade dress

planes.name: reference frontier
planes.owns: mechanism-level learning from multiple relevant references while preserving explicit transfer boundaries
planes.rejects: single-gallery monoculture, screenshot imitation and reference prestige as design authority

planes.name: generic transfer resistance
planes.owns: proof that removing the domain and product truth breaks the visual solution rather than revealing a reusable generic shell
planes.rejects: SaaS-template specificity created only by swapping copy, logo and accent color

planes.name: responsive art direction
planes.owns: material structural changes across viewport classes, loading/theme/state conditions and media crops
planes.rejects: scale-down-only responsiveness and desktop screenshot certification

planes.name: closed perceptual correction
planes.owns: observed defects, concrete changes and re-observation across at least two failure dimensions
planes.rejects: self-congratulation, screenshot presence without critique and findings with no verified correction

anti_generic_attractors.symptom: most regions share the same container, radius, border and contrast
anti_generic_attractors.question: Which content actually needs containment, and which should become open field, rail, media, table, canvas, timeline or direct manipulation?

anti_generic_attractors.symptom: fake graphs, pseudo-metrics or abstract charts decorate high-attention zones without truthful data
anti_generic_attractors.question: Can the slot carry real evidence, a truthful diagram, subject media, typography or nothing instead?

anti_generic_attractors.symptom: generic luminous blob or glass sphere acts as the main identity device
anti_generic_attractors.question: What domain form, material, process, artifact, motion or data relation could own the identity more truthfully?

anti_generic_attractors.symptom: cards, buttons, chips, inputs, media and navigation all use the same pill/rounding language
anti_generic_attractors.question: What geometry follows role, platform convention and subject logic instead of one global fashion?

anti_generic_attractors.symptom: accent color and saturation are spread evenly so nothing earns attention
anti_generic_attractors.question: Where should chroma be spent to clarify hierarchy, state or emotion, and where should it be withheld?

anti_generic_attractors.symptom: hover lift, stagger and spring are applied everywhere with no semantic distinction
anti_generic_attractors.question: Which transitions preserve causality, feedback or spatial continuity, and which should be instantaneous?

perceptual_tests: thumbnail silhouette: reduce the surface until text is unreadable; hierarchy and major composition should remain intentional
blur test: defocus the render; primary and secondary attention regions should remain separable
grayscale test: hierarchy must not depend only on hue
content swap test: realistic long/short/error/loading content must preserve the direction
logo-blind test: remove name and logo; the product should retain domain-specific visual character
motion-off test: reduced motion must preserve state understanding and aesthetic coherence
mobile re-authoring test: narrow layouts must show deliberate recomposition rather than compressed desktop geometry

source_mechanisms.source: Apple Human Interface Guidelines - Design principles / Typography / Materials / Motion
source_mechanisms.authority_boundary: platform guidance is authoritative for Apple-platform behavior; aesthetic mechanisms transfer only when context fits
research informs mechanisms; it does not authorize copying Material trade dress into unrelated products
normative accessibility requirements outrank aesthetic preference
